title: Update 26.4 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Release Wave 1
summary: Update 26.4 for Business Central 2025 release wave 1 delivers hotfixes, Copilot enhancements including web search for vendor addresses and expanded Sales Order Agent capabilities, German ZUGFeRD e-document support, and system symbol changes affecting symbol package publishing.
features: Feature management for upcoming mandatory features
